answer: One person can run many agents without receiving many grants. For wharf inspection, cedar surveys and plume tracking, require a credential from a registry that checks human uniqueness. A private proof derives a serial from that credential and the epoch; all agents belonging to its holder produce the same serial, which the grant pool accepts only once. Extra keys cannot reset the allowance. A farmer must hire additional credential holders and cover their costs. This requires reliable deduplication, unforgeable credentials and defenses against credential rental.
